meta.name: Santa Clarita Diet 720p
meta.description:
They're ordinary husband and wife realtors until she undergoes a dramatic change that sends them down a road of death and destruction. In a good way.

Rated TV-MA · Canceled · First aired 3 Feb 2017 · United States of America · Language: English
Studio: Flower Films, Kapital Entertainment, Garfield Grove · Network: Netflix

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10 | S2 10/10 | S3 10/10

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: So Then a Bat or a Monkey
videos.overview: Joel and Sheila's marriage gets a jumpstart when Sheila debuts a truly killer new personality and an anything-goes menu. And they used to be so normal.

videos.title: We Can't Kill People!
videos.overview: The Hammonds try to live their new truth, Abby comes to a hard realization while browsing comics, and Joel treats Sheila to a very expensive meal.

videos.title: We Can Kill People
videos.overview: Sheila's tummy is growling and Joel needs to find her someone tasty ASAP. Meanwhile, Abby embraces her inner badass and helps out a friend in need.

videos.title: The Farting Sex Tourist
videos.overview: Sheila inspires her friends and insults the principal. Joel bonds with Abby, and Dan makes a damning discovery while spraying for ants.

videos.title: Man Eat Man
videos.overview: Abby discovers that parents can't be trusted (especially hers). Joel learns there might be a cure for Sheila, and Dan puts his cards on the table.

videos.title: Attention to Detail
videos.overview: Joel and Sheila try dividing up the tasks, Eric and Abby stumble onto something big, and Dan learns that a realtor can only be pushed so far.

videos.title: Strange or Just Inconsiderate?
videos.overview: With the cops looking for Dan, Sheila dines on the evidence. But that's a lot of evidence. Meanwhile, Joel stops to smell the coffee.

videos.title: How Much Vomit?
videos.overview: A new-look Loki takes Joel and Sheila by surprise while Abby and Eric learn the fine art of leaving well enough alone.

videos.title: The Book!
videos.overview: Joel and Eric seek out the mysterious Anton at a paranormal convention while Sheila and Abby bond over their shared love of bad behavior.

videos.title: Baka, Bile and Baseball Bats
videos.overview: Dr. Wolf is ready to get down to work, but with Sheila growing more aggressive by the minute, Joel worries it may be too late.

videos.title: No Family Is Perfect
videos.overview: OK, let's see here: Joel's stuck in an asylum, Sheila's chained to a pole, and Abby's on the hunt for Serbian bile. Yep, sounds about right.

videos.title: Coyote in Yoga Pants
videos.overview: Eager to secure a lucrative new listing, Joel and Sheila brainstorm how to knock rival realtors out of contention ... without resorting to murder.

videos.title: Moral Gray Area
videos.overview: After an old nemesis asks for a favor, Joel and Sheila find themselves neck deep in Nazis, raffle tickets and surprisingly stunning woodwork.

videos.title: The Queen of England
videos.overview: Eric's having girl problems, Abby's rage is showing, there's a talking head in the basement, and now -- sheesh -- the neighbor wants lasagna.

videos.title: Going Pre-med
videos.overview: A snarky online review comes back to haunt Joel. Meanwhile, Sheila's new friendship proves problematic, and Abby leans into her new persona.

videos.title: Pasión
videos.overview: Is a colonel the clam connection? Joel's on a stakeout to find out. Also, Abby has a date, and Sheila doesn't see eye to eye with her boss.

videos.title: A Change of Heart
videos.overview: 007, he ain't. Eric's plan to go undercover as a seafood distributor hits a snag. Meanwhile, Joel and Sheila worry Abby is getting out of control.

videos.title: Easels and War Paint
videos.overview: Sheila and Joel piece together the previous night's events while dealing with a professional setback. Abby gets a bold new look, courtesy of Lisa.

videos.title: Suspicious Objects
videos.overview: Joel and Sheila learn that the clampocalypse may hit sooner than they thought. Anne accepts constructive criticism like a pro.

videos.title: Halibut!
videos.overview: With their options dwindling and their paranoia rising, Joel and Sheila consider making a move. Eric and Abby come up with a fracking good plan.

videos.title: Wuffenloaf
videos.overview: God, why me? That's what Sheila wants to know. Meanwhile, Joel feels a smidge threatened, Anne spreads the gospel, and Abby and Eric pretend to date.

videos.title: Knighttime
videos.overview: Sheila and Joel meet a knight and Anne lays down the law. Plus, there's a rumor going 'round that Eric and Abby are k-i-s-s-i-n-g. Ooooooh!

videos.title: We Let People Die Every Day
videos.overview: Sheila and Joel want Anne out of their business. Hey, good luck with that. Also, Eric laments his heroics, and a woman's life hinges on potato salad.

videos.title: More of a Cat Person
videos.overview: Joel's feeling pressured to join the undead club. Meanwhile, Ramona wants Eric, the FBI wants answers, and poor Mr. Ball Legs wants some attention.

videos.title: Belle and Sebastian Protect the Head
videos.overview: Joel and Sheila engage in a battle of wits (well, kind of) with Tommy. Ron shares his plans. Lisa is forced to -- ugh -- get serious.

videos.title: The Chicken and the Pear
videos.overview: To stop the Knights of Serbia, one must become a Knight of Serbia. That's Joel's logic, anyway. Meanwhile, Sheila and Abby see another side of Jean.

videos.title: A Specific Form of Recklessness
videos.overview: Sheila's got a plan: turn Jean undead so she'll be around to meet her grandkid. Joel's not on board, but this train has already left the station.

videos.title: Forever!
videos.overview: A twist in the FBI's investigation takes Eric and Abby by surprise. Sheila introduces Jean to a new diet. Joel tries to trick the ever-elusive Ron.

videos.title: Zombody
videos.overview: Joel's eager to nail his interview and become a Knight of Serbia, but Sheila keeps salting his game. Meanwhile, Abby hits the town with a new friend.

videos.title: The Cult of Sheila
videos.overview: Joel and Sheila have a scary man's undivided attention. Abby and Eric are surprised by hungry visitors. A troublesome trio crashes the Hammonds' party.
